title: 三十一、三十二
subject: a retired schoolteacher on the Sai Kung pier teaching himself to cast from a phone video every Sunday, counting every cast out loud
caption: Hong Kong math-folk in the math rock lineage. A fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar playing bright interlocking arpeggios against a clean electric guitar two-hand tapping and answering with chimed harmonics; a busy melodic electric bass running counter-lines; crisp dry drums with tight hi-hat work and stop-start accents; a light synth pad entering only in the last chorus. Odd and shifting meters, 7/8 verses opening into 4/4 choruses. Dry, close and small-room, guitars panned left and right, voice soft and centred. Soft, unforced female lead, conversational and slightly detached, with gentle harmonies on the chorus, Cantonese with a few English words. 132 BPM, E major. Patient, funny and quietly proud. No distorted power chords, no straight four-on-the-floor, no autotune, no trap drums, no strummed acoustic chords.
lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜日 七點 西貢碼頭
陳Sir退休咗兩年 支竿係新買
電話挨住個水桶 片入面個鬼佬講
"Relax your wrist" 佢跟住講「放鬆手腕」

[Pre-Chorus]
甩出去 條線打晒結
佢推一推眼鏡 由頭再嚟

[Chorus]
三十一 三十二
佢數得好似以前 喺課室點名
鉛墜跌喺船邊 跌喺自己對鞋度
三十三 佢話「唔緊要 再嚟」

[Verse]
賣魚蛋嘅阿姐 每個禮拜同佢一齊數
街渡阿伯開船之前 叫佢企開啲
有個細路問佢「阿伯 你釣到幾多條」
佢話「今日唔係釣魚 今日係上堂」

[Chorus]
五十七 五十八
佢數得好似以前 喺課室點名
條線飛出去 啱啱落喺嗰個橙色浮波
五十九 佢冇出聲 自己拍咗兩下手

[Outro]
"Lesson two"
下個禮拜 學收線
